economics.name: AtomicCreditReservationEconomics
economics.segments: ordered strict nonoverlapping half-open intervals in the ORIGINAL payment principal coordinate; each {startMinor,endMinor,nominalFeeMinor,retiredFeeMinor,assignedFeeMinor,provenCollectedMinor,owedFeeMinor}; count bounded within complete 5000 identity/segment inventory
economics.ordering: Economic coordinates are durable allocation proof, never alleged provider capture chronology. Actual authenticated predecessor membership and exact FK parent segment containment establish them; never timestamp/UUID/equal amount inference.
economics.conservation: For each exact parent segment: nominal=retired+assigned; assigned=proven+owed. Disjoint child intervals sum to their exact original cumulative-floor deltas. Every original nominal/retired/assigned/proven/owed unit remains in applied, reserved, genuinely released/unassigned or explicitly successor-locked capacity exactly once.
economics.formula: Within an authenticated original funding segment [s,e), N(x)=floor(rootFi*(s+x)/rootPrincipal)-floor(rootFi*s/rootPrincipal). A(x)=min(N(x), ORIGINAL segment assigned capacity). P(x)=min(A(x), ORIGINAL segment proven capacity). A subinterval [a,b) carries differences N(b)-N(a), A(b)-A(a), P(b)-P(a); retirement=N-A and owed=A-P. Segments inherited from a prior reservation preserve that segment's ORIGINAL caps and coordinates; they are not reset to the reservation's total assigned fee as a new rate.
economics.multipleSegments: An exact new reservation may need multiple free intervals after a genuine unapplied release. Choose a deterministic ascending economic coordinate from authenticated available intervals under the actual complete source prefix. Preserve each interval separately; never collapse holes into a guessed prefix. A released interval's journal remains full and may be reused only when no actual application exists and exact release authority remains valid.
economics.legacy: Existing non-B reservation/application floor rules and immutable scalar amounts stay exact. No historical child backfill or conversion from opaque feeEvidenceDigest/createdAt. Known B ancestry lacking the mandatory proof refuses. Genuine pre-B source applications retain their own provable legacy epoch rather than inventing an original root offset.
